_comment: Single source of truth for Resonance slash-command presentation. The Forge generates command documentation and per-tool shims from this map (see forge.py commands). Skill frontmatter remains the source of truth for semantic behavior. alias = the slash command the user types; skill = the canonical skill path under .agents/skills; manual = disable automatic invocation of this host shim. It does not block natural-language routing to the canonical skill and does not replace the skill's authority or approval gates.

help: Use `/brief` to recover intent and route unclear work. Use `/plan` when the intended outcome is already clear and needs an implementation plan.
Use `/grill` to interrogate a plan or goal contract before execution. Use `/council` to challenge a completed analysis or a consequential decision.
Use `/test` for test design and coverage, `/review-pr` for a concrete diff, `/audit` for a multi-specialist finding review, and `/system-health` for a repeatable health score.
Use `/goal` to drive an outcome across stages, `/build` to execute an approved implementation plan, and `/ship` to prepare and perform a release.

commands.desc: Bootstrap the .resonance/ project memory (soul, state, docs scaffold). Run once per new project.
Model the business, offer stack, and revenue math before planning.
Turn a feature or idea into an atomic, approved implementation plan. Deep research, 4-pass spec.
Stress-test a plan or design before any code: relentless one-question-at-a-time interrogation to shared understanding.
The autonomous goal loop: frame, decompose, then build and verify each slice against real checks, bounded, never auto-ship.
Turn a rough request into an intent-faithful execution brief, then run or route it within the user's authority.
Challenge an analysis or high-risk decision through relevant specialist reviews, debate, scenarios, and reconciliation.
Stress-test and expand a go-to-market campaign concept into a strategic blueprint with kill criteria.
Discover Existential Data Points in a B2B SaaS vertical. Positioning from nice-to-have to must-have.
Execute the implementation plan with a TDD loop (test, code, verify).
Root-cause a bug via the Scientific Method. Reproduction script required, no fix without a proven cause.
Atomic, behavior-preserving cleanup. Mikado method, safe sequence, SOLID.
Design or audit UI with elite craft: hierarchy, perceptual color, motion, and the subconscious detail layer.
Produce production-ready visual assets with structured prompt engineering.
Friction Collider: simulate the anti-persona to find and remove conversion drag.
Write or audit tests against the 8-Path Matrix. Destructive and property-based coverage.
Run the audit swarm (security, review, QA, architect) and output P0-P3 classified findings.
First-principles experience audit of a page or whole site: job, value promise, clarity, CTA, craft, function, trust, plus a forward backlog.
Audit a PR or diff against the Blocking Registry. Findings ranked by user harm, not by file order.
Independent second-model review of a diff, reconciled with the primary review.
Work the eval scorecard: sharpen the weakest skills or their rubrics and keep only changes that raise the measured lift.
Score system health 0-100 with qualitative flags (auth, env, test depth).
Release protocol: pre-flight checks, changelog, semantic version, tag, deploy.
Drive a live production incident: triage, severity, mitigate, comms, blameless postmortem.
Extract a portable behavioral voice profile from a corpus (person, brand, or character).
Analyze a call transcript for persona insights, objection patterns, and feature requests.
Generate a B2B cold-call script using the 6-part permission-based framework.
Render a pipeline analytics dashboard with velocity and forecasting from CRM data.
Document a solved problem in the correct Diataxis quadrant so it is never re-discovered.
Teach the operator, not the repo: a dense explainer of a concept, diff, or recent work, with an optional predict-then-reveal check-in.
Write an end-of-session handover doc: what was done, decisions, open TODOs, backlog.
Git-driven retrospective: shipping streak, focus score, complexity delta.
SEO and GEO audit: structured data, canonical, schema, AI-citation optimization.
Sync .resonance/01_state.md with the git log so the map matches the territory.
Upgrade the Resonance framework with backup and restore safety. Preserves .resonance/.
Author, validate, and eval a new Resonance skill with the Forge.
